page_title: BAY 4-1 MON | Bayern Munich v B. Monchengladbach 06/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
90+4' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) takes it short.
90+2' Bayern Munich take a short corner kick.
90+2' Bayern Munich work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' 4 - 1 Goal! Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top right corner. It's 4:1.
86' Bayern Munich are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
84' Eugen Polanski is forced to make a change. Hugo Bolin is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach).
83' The game is interrupted now, Hugo Bolin (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joshua Kimmich trots off the pitch and is replaced by David Daiber (Bayern Munich).

79' 4 - 0 Goal! Lennart Karl manages to prod the ball to Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the roof of the net. 4:0.
79' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
77' A corner kick by Bayern Munich is thwarted by the well prepared Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach).

76' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!

74' Joshua Kimmich sends a lofted pass into the box, Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) shows good awareness to connect with it but drags his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
72' B. Monchengladbach control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
70' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
67' Eugen Polanski is forced to make a change. Jens Castrop is unable to continue due to injury, Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
67' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
66' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Robert Schroder didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
61' Eugen Polanski has decided to substitute Haris Tabakovic and he is replaced by Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach).
61' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Franck Honorat as he is replaced by Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) will replace Luis Diaz.
61' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Dayot Upamecano is replaced by Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich).
61' Today's match ends for Konrad Laimer who will be replaced by Maycon Cardozo (Bayern Munich).
57' 3 - 0 Goal! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Moritz Nicolas into the bottom right corner.
57' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is going to take the penalty!
55' What an awful challenge. The referee Robert Schroder has no other option than to send Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) off the pitch. Red card!
55' Robert Schroder blows his whistle and signals a foul after Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) brought his opponent down. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Bayern Munich.
54' Wonderful movement by Bayern Munich. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

52' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
52' The B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' Luis Diaz received a clever long ball from Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
47' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
46' Vincent Kompany makes a switch. Jonas Urbig (Bayern Munich) is coming on in place of Manuel Neuer at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Robert Schroder starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' 2 - 0 Luis Diaz feeds the ball through to Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the top left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 2:0!
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

44' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
40' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
38' The corner from Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) is cleared away by the defence.
35' Referee Robert Schroder signals NO PENALTY for Bayern Munich after a VAR review!
35' PENALTY APPEAL by Bayern Munich, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

33' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the right side of the target. The assist goes to Leon Goretzka and the score changes to 1:0.
32' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
30' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) serves up a nice cross, but Moritz Nicolas punches the ball away.
29' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) and Joshua Kimmich matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
28' 61:39 – the latest ball possession ratio.
26' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) launches a cross from the corner, but Moritz Nicolas is alert to thwart the effort.

25' A neat pass is well received by Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the top left corner. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayern Munich are going to take it.
24' Hugo Bolin (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find Haris Tabakovic, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
22' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) and Luis Diaz combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
22' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bayern Munich.
20' A cross by Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.

15' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.

15' Bayern Munich players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
13' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas was alert and made a comfortable save.
13' Nicolas Jackson latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) and heads towards goal.
13' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends an accurate pass to Luis Diaz, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
10' A goal, which was scored by Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich), was disallowed due to offside.
8' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

7' B. Monchengladbach exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bayern Munich are taking a throw-in.
5' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
5' The B. Monchengladbach players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
4' Great teamplay by B. Monchengladbach as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Manuel Neuer easily deals with the threat.
2' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

2' Hugo Bolin (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.

B. Monchengladbach will kick-off.
